name: Exact-count GIF

english.title: Animated image
english.body:
This GIF contains 3 frames. AN Paint edits still images and does not preserve animation.

Only the first frame will be imported. Saving creates a still image.

portuguese.body:

Apenas o primeiro quadro será importado. Salvar cria uma imagem estática.
